 Rain, strong winds lash parts of Rajasthan; temperature likely to drop
 PTI 
 29 October, 2026 04:53 pm IST

 Jaipur, Oct 29 (PTI) A fresh western disturbance brought a change in weather across several parts of Rajasthan on Thursday, with cloudy skies and drizzle reported at many places.
 According to the Meteorological Department, an induced circulation over Punjab and adjoining areas is likely to bring rain and strong winds to parts of eastern Rajasthan.
 The department has forecast winds reaching speeds of 40-50 kmph in parts of Jaipur, Bharatpur, Ajmer, Kota and Udaipur divisions.
 Show Full Article
 Moderate to heavy rain accompanied by isolated hailstorms is also likely in northern parts of Jaipur and Bharatpur divisions.
 The maximum temperature is expected to fall by 3-5 degrees Celsius over the next 24 hours, it said.
 Light to moderate rain accompanied by strong winds is likely at isolated places in eastern Rajasthan on Friday, while parts of Jodhpur and Bikaner divisions may also witness cloudy skies and light rain.
 Isolated rainfall is expected to continue in eastern Rajasthan on October 31, before largely dry weather returns to most parts of the state from November 1. PTI AG SKY
